Package neqsim.thermo.util.mineral

Class SolidGasReactionEquilibrium

java.lang.Object
neqsim.thermo.util.mineral.SolidGasReactionEquilibrium
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class SolidGasReactionEquilibrium extends Object implements Serializable
Equilibrium of a heterogeneous reaction between pure solids, liquid water and gases.

The standard equilibrium constant follows from phase-specific thermochemistry, ln K(T) = -sum(nu_i G_i(T)) / (R T), with ideal-gas standard states at 1 bar and pure condensed phases. At pressure P the gas fugacity quotient at equilibrium is

prod_gas (f_i / p0)^nu_i = K(T) * exp(-sum_condensed nu_j I_j(T,P) / (R T)) / prod_condensed a_j^nu_j

where I_j is the pressure integral of the condensed-phase molar volume and a_j the activity (water activity for brines, 1 for pure solids). Gas non-ideality is not part of this relation: it enters through the fugacities that solveGasExchange(SystemInterface, String, String, ExchangeMode) takes from a NeqSim equation of state. Total pressure cancels only for the ideal-gas part when the gas stoichiometry is balanced; fugacity coefficients still matter.

Results are a thermodynamic limit: kinetics, mineral availability, polymorph identity (for example troilite versus mackinawite) and aqueous speciation are outside the model.

1.0

esol

    • solveForGas

      public SolidGasReactionEquilibrium.GasExchangeResult solveForGas(SystemInterface fluid, String targetGas)
      Solves for the amount of one gas that satisfies the reaction equilibrium while the fugacities of all other gas species in the reaction follow from the fluid itself.

      This is the general form for mineral buffers with several gases, for example 4 FeS2 + CH4 + 2 H2O(l) = 4 FeS + 4 H2S + CO2, where the CH4 and CO2 fugacities of a reservoir fluid set the buffered H2S fugacity. Only the target gas amount is changed; because the other gases are present in large amounts, their fugacities move only through the small composition change. Fugacities are equal in all phases at equilibrium and are read from phase 0.

      Parameters:
      fluid - fluid containing every gas species of the reaction (target may start at a trace)
      targetGas - component name of the gas to solve for, for example "H2S"
      Returns:
      equilibrium result; reactant fields refer to no partner gas and are NaN
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if a gas species is missing from the fluid or has zero amount

    • solveGasExchange

      public SolidGasReactionEquilibrium.GasExchangeResult solveGasExchange(SystemInterface fluid, String productGas, String reactantGas, SolidGasReactionEquilibrium.ExchangeMode mode)
      Solves for the product-gas amount that satisfies the reaction equilibrium in a fluid.

      The fluid is cloned and flashed at its own temperature and pressure. Fugacities are taken from the equation of state of the fluid, so gas and liquid non-ideality, phase splits and the dissolution of gases in water or oil are all included. The input fluid is not modified.

      Parameters:
      fluid - fluid containing the product and reactant gas components
      productGas - component name of the product gas, for example "H2S"
      reactantGas - component name of the reactant gas, for example "CO2"
      mode - how the gas inventory responds to the reaction
      Returns:
      equilibrium result
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if components or reaction gases are missing or inconsistent
